title: Publish a report as a print-management format via the delegate
instruction: In the sandbox model, publish a report to print management the way the platform expects, WITHOUT editing any shipped object. (1) Scaffold an SSRS report named DemoPrintFmt over ConDemoNoteHeader with generate_object(mode="scaffold", objectType="report", fieldsHint="NoteId, Subject", generateController=false); note the design name the scaffold gives it, because ssrsReportStr is compile-time checked against it. (2) Create ONE event-handler class with d365fo_file(action="create", objectType="class") that subscribes to the delegate on PrintMgmtDocType: [SubscribesTo(classStr(PrintMgmtDocType), delegateStr(PrintMgmtDocType, getDefaultReportFormatDelegate))], with the delegate's own signature (PrintMgmtDocumentType _docType, EventHandlerResult _result). Switch on the document type, answer only for PrintMgmtDocumentType::SalesFreeTextInvoice, and return the format through _result.result(ssrsReportStr(<the report>, <its design>)). A delegate answers by SETTING the result, never by returning a value: the delegate is `void`. Do NOT extend PrintMgmtDocumentType and do NOT modify PrintMgmtDocType itself; both are shipped and the delegate exists precisely so you do not have to. Build the model; it must compile with zero errors and zero warnings.
